service_failure_pair.note: brief gives service_error only for create_promise; used as fallback for other tool failures

value.opening: Hello, this is the digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We are recording this call.
value.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
value.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
value.no_info: I am sorry, I do not have that information.
value.sorry_loss: I am sorry for your loss.
value.protect: These security questions protect your account.
value.ask_dob: For security, could you please tell me your date of birth?
value.ask_phone: Thank you. Now, could you tell me the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?
value.swapped: Could you please say the month of your date of birth as a word, for example March?
value.failed: I am sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
value.collections: Thank you, you are verified. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
value.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
value.sms: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
value.paid: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear.
value.change_app: A recorded promise cannot be changed in this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
value.no_discount: I am sorry, I cannot offer a discount, a waiver or any other terms.
value.human_first: Before I transfer you, is there anything I can help you with myself?
value.tech: There was a technical problem, I will try once more.
value.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
